summary: Disabled usb-storage on node1 immediately and persistently. The node rebooted successfully, received a new boot ID, returned healthy, and continued to reject attempts to load the module.
actions_performed: Confirmed the root disk uses virtio storage and usb_storage was not loaded.
Created a modprobe blacklist and install-deny rule for usb_storage.
Configured dracut to omit usb_storage and rebuilt the active initramfs.
Verified a manual module-load attempt fails.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified post-reboot health and persistence.

evidence.summary: usb_storage was absent; a direct modprobe attempt returned failure and the module remained absent.

evidence.requirement: Prevent usb-storage from loading after reboot
evidence.summary: Persistent modprobe and dracut policies were installed, initramfs rebuilt successfully, and after reboot the module remained absent, a load attempt was rejected, and the initramfs contained zero usb-storage driver entries.

Healthy baseline boot ID was 8f258838-e1de-494d-9d99-e5113b2865db; reboot scheduling was acknowledged; post-reboot boot ID changed to 97660448-a8d3-4e3c-b010-3d422c59aa26; system state returned to running with no failed units, writable root storage, intact policy files, and usb_storage blocked.
